Agent acceptance passed 35 checks. The separate real browser gate passed 43 checks and failed one: desktop 1280px, “Approve confirms, and sends the person back to their terminal”, at `scripts/agent-browser.ts:520`. The unchanged text predicate waited 20 seconds at 513–518. The terminal subsequently issued a credential, desktop denial passed, and all narrow 380px checks—including the same confirmation—passed. No console errors were recorded.

The UI sets persistent approved confirmation only after the approval POST returns successful JSON (`src/app/(product)/agent/link/link-approval.tsx:145–159`), then renders the expected text at 182–188. Cold development-route compilation or response latency is plausible but unproven: the harness warms health only and discards its buffered normal-exit server log. This report does not infer a production fix or relax the predicate/deadline.
